simple.meaning: דָּשָׁא (dâshâʼ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to sprout.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Genesis, Joel, beginning at Genesis 1:11. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּשָׁא (H1876).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: דָּשָׁא (dâshâʼ) / H1876 is traced through Genesis 1:11, Joel 2:22 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H1876. dasha [ דָּשָׁא ] verb sprout, shoot, grow green (Assyrian dašû Pi`el make abundant Lyon Sargontexte 77 ; compare also below דֶּשֶׁא , whence, according to others, verb denominative) — Qal Perfect דָּֽשְׁאוּ Joel 2:22 (subject מִדְבָּר נְאוֺת ). Hiph`il Imperfect 3feminine singular תַּדְשֵׁא (jussive) Gen 1:11 cause to sprout or shoot forth דֶּשֶׁא הָאָרֶץ תַּדְשֵׁא . — דָּשָׁא Jer 50:11 see below דּוּשׁ .
